title: Roles & Permissions
description: Choose what managers and users are allowed to do. Admins always have every permission.

roleHints.user: The default role for members. Users can do exactly what is ticked in this column, and nothing else.
roleHints.manager: A member with its own, usually wider set of permissions — grant more than users get without making someone an admin.
roleHints.admin: Full access to the organisation and to these settings. Admins always hold every permission and cannot be restricted.

permissionHints.assign_users_to_teams: Add members to a team and remove them again. Does not allow creating or deleting teams.
permissionHints.manage_skills: Create, edit and delete skills, including their instructions, sources and integrations.
permissionHints.share_skills_with_teams: Make a skill available to teams the member belongs to.
permissionHints.share_skills_with_org: Make a skill available to the whole organisation.
permissionHints.manage_knowledge_bases: Create, edit and delete knowledge bases and the documents inside them.
permissionHints.share_knowledge_bases_with_teams: Make a knowledge base available to teams the member belongs to.
permissionHints.share_knowledge_bases_with_org: Make a knowledge base available to the whole organisation.
permissionHints.manage_routines: Create, edit, delete and run routines.

permissions.share_knowledge_bases_with_teams: Share knowledge bases with own teams
permissions.share_knowledge_bases_with_org: Share knowledge bases with the organisation

adminHint: Admins always have every permission and cannot be restricted.
minOnePermission: Each role must keep at least one permission
